headline: Song Yadong rises in divisional rankings after shocking KO
description: Here's a look at every weight class to determine the best of the best in UFC, PFL and beyond.

headline: Song Yadong KO's Umar Nurmagomedov in massive UFC upset
description: Song Yadong pulled off a massive upset by knocking out heavily favored Umar Nurmagomedov in the men's bantamweight main event of UFC Fight Night in Shanghai.

headline: Injured UFC champion Ulberg hopes to return 'early next year'
description: UFC light heavyweight champion Carlos Ulberg, who is recovering from an ACL tear, hopes to return to the Octagon "early next year," he says.

headline: Cris Cyborg is still going strong as a force in women's P4P top 10
description: At age 41, PFL women's featherweight champion continues win streak to secure spot in ESPN P4P top 10.

headline: Alex Apodaca stuns MMA prodigy Bella Mir to earn UFC deal
description: Alex Apodaca beat MMA prodigy Bella Mir in the biggest upset in Contender Series history Tuesday to earn a UFC contract.

headline: 'Right now, I could be UFC champion': Bella Mir is the future face of fighting
description: With Dana White as her mentor, the daughter of heavyweight champ Frank grapples for an NCAA title this weekend.

headline: Holloway: 'Delusional' McGregor 'looked old' in UFC 329 loss
description: UFC star Max Holloway responded to some recent trash talk by Conor McGregor, saying the brash Irishman is "delusional" for all the comments McGregor has made since their meeting at UFC 329.

headline: Cejudo, former 2-division UFC champ, to box influencer Sept. 26
description: Henry Cejudo, a former two-division champion in the UFC, will make his professional boxing debut against Deen The Great on Sept. 26 in Miami.

headline: Rodriguez out of Silva bout at UFC Noche, replaced by Delgado
description: Former interim champion Yair Rodriguez has withdrawn from his Sept. 12 UFC Noche bout against Jean Silva and will be replaced by Jose Delgado.

headline: Should Prates or Morales be next to challenge the pound-for-pound king?
description: Two exciting welterweights, Carlos Prates and Michael Morales, have now entered the Islam Makhachev sweepstakes.
